summary: Repaired the hard binomial answer-bank shortcut and strengthened deterministic batch ordering. Easy, moderate, and hard passed together. The report validator passed; publication remains runner-owned.

source_analysis.skill: Simplify trigonometric ratios using the sine double-angle identity, cancellation, reciprocal ratios, and source-supported Pythagorean identities and factoring.
reasoning_steps: Expand sin(2x) and rewrite reciprocal or quotient functions.
Cancel nonzero factors on the original domain.
For hard cases, apply the Pythagorean identity and factor before cancelling.
invariants: Retain ratio simplification and the five-choice radio response.
Require one correct answer and distinct, plausible distractors.
permitted_variations: Which factor cancels and which function survives.
Small coefficients, binomial signs, and term order.
Complete error profiles and answer ordering.

source_replay.details: Independently replayed 12 complete source prompts, all 60 choices, and their keys. Partial imports remain unchanged.

math.details: Checked 134 records, every choice and displayed derivation row, and 20 generic symbolic shapes. Every final question has one correct answer and distinct distractors.

variety.details: Verified seven supported families, both function roles, hard signs, error profiles, notation, rejection/resampling, deduplication, and selection behavior. Delivery retained all five final and all 24 fresh records per band.

scope.details: Traced every served family through displayed, source-supported conversions to its key. An equivalent but unshown parity rewrite fails the negative control.

grading.details: The actual native grader accepted 134 correct selections and rejected 536 distractor selections, with zero unresolved outcomes. All fields are radio.

rendering.details: Rendered and inspected all 15 final questions plus 19 controlled records. Every intended math span and aligned row reached the UI; five answer controls and bold emphasis render correctly.

packaging.details: Verified exact Python 3.13.5 dependency declarations, deterministic replay, relocation, and current package/engine identities. Finalization regenerated all bands. No shared-code changes were needed.

decision_variation.details: The original bank-only shortcut succeeded on 6/6 controlled binomial cases; after repair it succeeds on 0/6. Relevant and irrelevant counterfactuals, conditional probes, delivered batches, and actual UI ordering were checked separately.

progression.details: All bands retain unguided ratio simplification and radio selection. Progression adds reciprocal/residual-factor decisions, then Pythagorean replacement and factoring, while keeping arithmetic manageable. Imported labels and level coverage remain unchanged.

easy.details: All five final questions passed correctness, native grading, rendering, delivery, and applicable coverage/shortcut checks.

moderate.details: All five final questions passed correctness, native grading, rendering, delivery, and applicable coverage/shortcut checks.

hard.details: All five final questions passed correctness, native grading, rendering, delivery, and applicable coverage/shortcut checks, including the repaired binomial banks.
